candidates.topic: Motivational action through a physical problem
candidates.hook: A courier can lift a heavy gate, but it falls every time they reach for the parcel.
candidates.action: After two clear failed attempts, the courier stops forcing it and attaches the parcel cart to the existing counterweight. Close-ups show why it stays open.
candidates.payoff: The courier rolls through; a line of waiting townspeople follows. End on the gate staying open, not a generic motivational slogan.
visual_plan: Show the gate falling and the parcel simultaneously.
Keep the person, hinge and weight geography readable.
Show the changed force path through specific original animation.
Finish on other people passing through the held gate.
candidates.source_plan: A new original scene and animation; no stock placeholder or reused lighthouse footage.

candidates.hook: A dark street and a power cell with enough charge for one lamp.
candidates.action: The courier uses the cell to light a public crossing. A second resident connects a lamp; then another joins.
candidates.payoff: The camera pulls back to a whole route lit by many contributions. The original single lamp stays visible as a callback.
visual_plan: Show the actual power shortage and one working cell.
Follow the physical connection into the crossing.
Give each added light a visible human cause.
Use the wide reveal only after those causes are established.
candidates.source_plan: New original street, residents and animation; fictional technology, not an engineering demonstration.

candidates.hook: The bell rings in a railway station after its final train has gone.
candidates.action: A cleaner follows irregular tapping below the platform and discovers a little maintenance robot striking the bell with a wrench while its charge fades.
candidates.payoff: The cleaner reconnects its charger. Next morning the robot deliberately rings the same pattern as the cleaner waves goodbye. The opening sound now means communication.
visual_plan: Open on the bell moving in an empty station.
Use a listening reaction and a low tracking shot toward the tapping.
Reveal the robot, wrench and dim battery in one understandable composition.
Show the charger connection and a specific recovered movement.
Return to the bell and matching wave as the resolution.
candidates.source_plan: New original cleaner/robot characters and station geometry. Original bells and licensed score, no real broadcast or cloned speaker.
